issues.explanation: The definition cross-references «داده‌پردازی (۳-۱-۱۹)» but 3.1.19 is the very entry being defined (distributed data processing), not plain «data processing». This self-referential cross-reference is reproduced exactly from the printed evidence, so the proposed is faithful and cannot be edited here; editors should verify against the INSO/ISO source page and consider an editorial note flagging the anomaly.

The printed definition reads «مجموعه‌ای نام‌دار از پرونده‌ها که به‌عنوان یک واحد در نظر گرفته می‌شود» — a named collection of *files* (پرونده‌ها), making the definition self-referential. ISO/IEC 20546:2019 defines «file» as a named set of *records*, where «records» should render as «رکوردها» or «سوابق», not «پرونده‌ها». Per rule 5 the printed evidence letter-accuracy cannot be questioned; the proposed is faithful to it. Editors should flag this as a potential translation error in the INSO source and consider an editorial caveat.

The printed term «گردآورد(جمع‌آوری)» is a standard INSO printing convention: the primary term followed by its alias in parentheses. The proposed correctly extracts «گردآورد» as the preferred term and «جمع‌آوری» as an alias. However, the combined printing-convention form «گردآورد(جمع‌آوری)» appears in alternatives_fa as if it were a standalone usable term — it is not; it is merely the typographic form from the page. Remove «گردآورد(جمع‌آوری)» from alternatives_fa and retain only «جمع‌آوری».
issues.suggested_fix: Set alternatives_fa to ["جمع‌آوری"] only; drop «گردآورد(جمع‌آوری)» from the list.
